data.content: Robert Mills is an author (fiction and non-fiction) who publishes on KDP. He prefers: compact/bullet responses, iterative design feedback (expects revision rounds), bold book covers with large text that can overlap artwork, dark/high-contrast color schemes, and quadrant/radial timeline concepts for memoir covers. Very detail-oriented about editorial quality — wants grammar passes, POV consistency checks, and proper front/back matter on every book.
